Name: Zechariah, Son of Asaph
Summary: Zechariah, of the sons of Asaph, was one of the Levites who arose to cleanse the house of the LORD under Hezekiah.
KeyStory: Of the sons of Asaph, Zechariah and Mattaniah arose to cleanse the house.
RelatedPeople: Mattaniah, Son of Asaph; King Hezekiah; Asaph
LifeLesson: Asaph's singers also cleansed the house where they sang.
